pieces.Text: [Not Implemented] The need to avenge those you loved drives you to great deeds.

You gain a +1 bonus on saving throws, attack rolls, and weapon damage rolls against your chosen foe and known minions of that foe. Goal:Thwart your chosen foe. Completion Benef it:You gain a +1 bonus on all saving throws. This bonus stacks with this feats's bonus against your foe and its minions, should they survive.

Situational.text: Prerequisite:You must have a close family member or other loved one slain by a specific challenging foe or that foe's minions, or have the Raiders or Vengeance background.
